Harvest UNIT-COMPLETE and CLOUD-OK-REFUTE.json were not trusted (that refute still claims version_guard token count 0 against an old r2e_loop sha256; live process_unit has the guard). probe-a hash_unchanged=true (before=after=5d11ba5c9c2ee5123f0eb2ad70bf7d2684a08e17ad30d096f073e27f7115a6eb); leftover TST-9159.json generation remains original-terminal-after-false-timeout; writer_calls=0; race logs dir empty; process_result_last=duplicate-completion-suppressed. probe-b duplicate_completion_event_count=1; leftover events.jsonl and TST-9159.json.duplicate-completion.json both name event=DUPLICATE-COMPLETION why='suppressed write of completed receipt' suppressed_write=true suppressed_stage=ground incumbent_hash=5d11ba5c... matching probe-a. both-states hash_changed=true (c1a1bdac263d111aea3b0c6ab9915ecfd5bdff062393703e242578a6e86da93d -> 6254cbc3ac4249fd23a3cbcdf9ece9ef2da31db9e00e5c73f8e922efbb426183); writer_calls=3 stage_calls=[ground,implement,refute]; leftover TST-9259.json is generation=retry-refute with UNIT-COMPLETE:TST-9259 and three stub logs; that events.jsonl has no DUPLICATE-COMPLETION. oracle silent_on_good=true (known-good: receipt_hash_unchanged=true dup=1 oracle_pass=true); fired_on_bad=true (last-write-wins: before!=after dup=0 ORACLE-RED). version_guard is a real gate in process_unit, not a token garnish: the ground/implement/refute loop calls it at lines 409 and 417 and line 417 is `if not guard['ok']` before run_codex; fix/rerefute consult it at 439/453. For this false-negative race expected_hash is null and the completeness gate is what holds write-once. Static audit: version_guard_calls_inside_ground_implement_refute_loop=[417, 409], tail_complete inside that loop=[408], DUPLICATE-COMPLETION literal present.
